Quick tech note from the SE side: happy to run the technical portion. A few asks up front to avoid delays during the kickoff:
- Network/egress model: will the POC use a shared sandbox or your VPC (details during kickoff)
- Sample dataset: a small representative CSV (5–10k rows) and a schema file
- Access: a read-only service account or temporary credentials for staging

Proposal for technical sequencing (post-kickoff):
1) SE deep-dive (90m) — architecture, data ingest, SSO & IAM
2) Workload profile run (we'll run a 1k token warmup to measure latency)
3) Short evaluation report (2–3 business days)

Also attaching our standard security questionnaire; Priya / security contact should scan it and we can prefill parts before the formal review.

Attachment: security-questionnaire.pdf
